name: Direct-to-Fan Monetization Playbook & Funnel Templates
description: Streaming platforms pay fractions of a cent per stream, making it impossible to earn a living without millions of streams unless artists sell directly to fans.
buyer: Independent recording artists and self-managed musicians
core_problem: Streaming platforms pay fractions of a cent per stream, making it impossible to earn a living without millions of streams unless artists sell directly to fans.
desired_outcome: Build sustainable direct revenue streams (Bandcamp, merchandise, VIP memberships) that turn passive listeners into high-value paying fans.
current_solutions: Selling music directly to fans on platforms like Bandcamp
Relying on live performances and physical merchandise sales
Distributing music across platforms offering higher per-stream rates
solution_gaps: Artists lack structured funnels to convert casual streaming listeners into direct buyers
No simple playbook for pricing, bundling, or launching direct-to-fan digital/physical products
possible_product: A step-by-step fan funnel strategy guide with Notion templates for product pricing, launch calendars, and email nurture sequences.
basis: Low payouts are an existential issue for indie artists; direct-to-fan strategies are proven alternative solutions but lack clear execution blueprints.

problems.statement: Independent artists earn extremely low royalty payouts per stream, making it difficult to generate a sustainable income without millions of monthly streams.
problems.desired_outcome: Earn a fair, living wage from streaming releases without requiring millions of streams per month.
current_solutions: Selling music directly to fans on platforms like Bandcamp
Relying on live performances and physical merchandise sales
Distributing music across platforms offering higher per-stream rates
attempts: Releasing tracks exclusively on digital streaming platforms
Pushing for continuous stream volume to meet minimum payment thresholds
solution_complaints: Spotify requires approximately 250,000 monthly streams just to earn $1,000
Minimum stream thresholds prevent small artists from receiving any payout on low-volume tracks
Platform monetization models heavily favor major record labels over independent creators
